title: Triticale varieties, cernoziom, no irrigation, small holding in Dobrogea
rationale: Triticale is the crop with enough varieties to rank on a Dobrogea case (secara has a single variety, Suceveana, so a variety case for it would assert nothing). FDL Caltrit and FDL Ascendent are the two with drought_tolerance ridicata; Zaraza, Utrifun and Tulnic are medie. The parcel is dryland in the Dobrogea steppe — 2 drought-flagged years in 10, a -8.4 mm last-month precipitation anomaly, 552 mm annual normal — so one of the two must lead and each must outrank a medie one. Both leaders also name 'câmpia din sud și vest' among their recommended zones, and FDL Ascendent names 'soluri fertile din câmpia de sud și vest', which matches a cernoziom parcel.
